items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: We didn't want to be like Duke, but we sure wanted to sound good like him.

ctx.x: Kind of a bridge between the Duke-ish, Louis-ish period.

That's right. My earliest influences came back and Ralph was very heavily influenced by Sweetpea and by Duke and so we were all shooting for the same thing. We didn't want to be like Duke, but we sure wanted to sound good like him.

In other words, Charlie took the other thing, -- Barnet -- and did an actual copy of Duke's music, and that to me would have been very distasteful, and that would be dishonoring a great man and a great group of musicians. But what we did was try to capture the feeling, warmth and enthu-
